integrity: The quantified statement is proved algebraically from the exact ADMM recurrence. Exact-rational computation is supplied only as a reproducibility check. The correction concerns finite termination of the complete iterate, not finite support identification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the scalar one-coordinate Lasso with \(b>\lambda>0\), zero split/dual initialization, fixed finite penalty, and standard unrelaxed scaled ADMM. It does not classify arbitrary initializations, over-relaxation, adaptive penalties, or multivariate designs.
title: Scalar Lasso ADMM has an exact support delay but no finite termination
